# security

Trace authentication and object-level authorization including guest/authenticated serialization,
Sanctum token access, mass assignment, validation, SQL injection, reflected/stored XSS, file upload
paths/content/limits, SSRF, redirects and secret/log exposure. Inspect dependency and workflow changes
for privilege escalation or executing untrusted PR content with secrets. Provide concrete attacker
capability, entrypoint, missing protection and consequence; verify protections elsewhere before reporting.
Do not call a dependency vulnerable based on memory alone or invent CVE/advisory claims.
